WITH x(id,city,amount) AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES (1,'Jakarta',10),(2,'Jakarta',20),(3,'Bandung',30)) SELECT city,SUM(amount) FROM x GROUP BY city ORDER BY city

WITH x(id,city,amount) AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES (1,'Jakarta',10),(2,'Jakarta',20),(3,'Bandung',30)) SELECT id,city,amount FROM x QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY city ORDER BY amount DESC)=1 ORDER BY id
WITH x(city,amount) AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('Jakarta',10),('Jakarta',20),('Bandung',30)) SELECT city,SUM(amount) FROM x GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY city
WITH x(id,city,amount) AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES (1,'Jakarta',10)) SELECT * EXCLUDE city REPLACE(amount*2 AS amount) RENAME id AS order_id FROM x
WITH x(order_id,city,amount) AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES (1,'Jakarta',10)) SELECT * ILIKE '%id%' FROM x

WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM n WHERE i<5) SELECT SUM(i) FROM n
SELECT * FROM (SELECT column1 AS city,column2 AS quarter,column3 AS revenue FROM VALUES ('Jakarta','Q1',10),('Jakarta','Q2',20)) PIVOT(SUM(revenue) FOR quarter IN ('Q1','Q2'))
SELECT metric,value FROM (SELECT 10 AS sales,20 AS costs) UNPIVOT(value FOR metric IN(sales,costs)) ORDER BY metric
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT=>10))

WITH trades(id,ts) AS (SELECT 1,'2026-10-13 10:05:00'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ),quotes(price,ts) AS (SELECT 100,'2026-10-13 10:00:00'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ UNION ALL SELECT 200,'2026-10-13 10:10:00'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) SELECT t.id,q.price FROM trades t ASOF JOIN quotes q MATCH_CONDITION(t.ts>=q.ts)

SELECT * FROM (SELECT column1 AS pos,column2 AS value FROM VALUES(1,10),(2,20),(3,30)) MATCH_RECOGNIZE(ORDER BY pos MEASURES FIRST(pos) AS start_pos,LAST(pos) AS end_pos ONE ROW PER MATCH PATTERN(A B+) DEFINE A AS TRUE,B AS value>PREV(value))
WITH x(city,amount) AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES('Jakarta',10),('Bandung',20)) SELECT COALESCE(city,'TOTAL'),SUM(amount),GROUPING(city) FROM x GROUP BY ROLLUP(city) ORDER BY GROUPING(city),city

SELECT id,city,TO_VARCHAR(amount),payload:channel::VARCHAR FROM SF_RESEARCH_20261013_ORDERS ORDER BY id

MERGE INTO SF_RESEARCH_20261013_ORDERS t USING (SELECT column1 AS id,column2 AS city,column3 AS amount FROM VALUES(2,'Bandung',25),(3,'Surabaya',30)) s ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET amount=s.amount WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(id,city,amount) VALUES(s.id,s.city,s.amount)
